customManagers.description: Container images pinned by digest where no built-in manager reads them: the release workflow's build container expression and the Bazel execution platforms.

The sccache release every sccache-action step installs (the action would otherwise take the newest at run time), and the one setup-sccache-ci downloads, whose pinned SCCACHE_SHA256 an update must change too: its install fails until it matches.
The mold release setup-mold-ci installs as the CI lanes' linker (its release tags carry a v prefix, MOLD_VERSION none).
The cargo-nextest release setup-cargo-tool-ci installs (its release tags are cargo-nextest-<version>), whose pinned NEXTEST_SHA256 an update must change too: the install fails until it matches.
The cargo-deny release setup-cargo-tool-ci installs, whose pinned CARGO_DENY_SHA256 an update must change too: the install fails until it matches.

packageRules.description: Keep routine dependency updates in one validation train

Patch updates automerge without a review, so each waits until its release is a week old (scripts/ci-action-pins.mjs requires the age on every automerge rule): a version without a release date is held (minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour defaults to timestamp-required), a version still within the week is skipped for the newest one past it (internalChecksFilter defaults to strict). Vulnerability fixes are not held (vulnerabilityAlerts sets no minimumReleaseAge), so vulnerabilityAlerts turns automerge off: a security fix arrives at once as a pull request for review.

A digest update of a pinned action (its tag now names another commit) waits for approval on the dependency dashboard: minimumReleaseAge holds back new versions only, and a moved tag keeps its original date.

What the customManagers above pin (container digests, the sccache, mold, cargo-nextest and cargo-deny releases) builds CI and the release: proposed a week after its release, in a group of its own, and never automerged.

The YAML parser reads SKILL.md frontmatter that arrives from HTTP and git sources: serde-saphyr is pinned exactly in Cargo.toml, and a new version of it or of its parser granit-parser is proposed a week after its release and never automerged.

GitHub Actions run with the workflow token, OIDC and release secrets: pinned to commit SHAs (helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests, checked by scripts/ci-action-pins.mjs), new versions proposed a week after their release, in a group of their own, and never automerged. Keep this rule last.
